legacy_history: 002Window 17 July to 15 October 2026; data collected 15 October 2026. SnapshotA random 50-account sample of Greater Toronto Area med spas, observed over 90 days.
001Data collected 10 September 2026 and re-collected for the top 25 on 11 September 2026. SnapshotFirst edition: 176 ranked clinics of 341 with a public account.

hub_legacy.geo: Editions 001 and 002: the City of Toronto plus Durham, Halton, Peel and York regions.
hub_legacy.period: Editions 001 and 002 used 90-day windows: edition 002 covers 17 July to 15 October 2026, collected on 15 October. Edition 001 covers 12 June to 10 September 2026, collected on 10 September with a re-collection of the top 25 on 11 September.
hub_legacy.sample: Edition 002: 50 accounts selected by a seeded, region-proportional random draw from Google Maps discovery. 36 had posts observed, 12 showed no recent posts, 1 is restricted by Instagram and 1 could not be confirmed, so posting activity is analysed for 48 and post-level figures for 36. Edition 001: 341 clinic accounts found municipality by municipality; 176 recorded with three or more reels in the window and given a provisional rank.
hub_legacy.limits: Edition 002 is a sample of a sample, not every GTA clinic; it has no ranking or score, it cannot prove complete paging of each account’s window, and its profile check wrongly counted one restricted account as public. The two editions are not compared. Edition 001 ranks are provisional. The raw ranking collection was not kept, so no score can be recalculated; three clinics in the top 25 may not meet the three-reel requirement; and the two collections disagree for ten of the top 25. The page lists each conflict.
hub_legacy.learn: Edition 002: what the reels of the accounts that posted record, how the observed posts split by format, and how many selected accounts could and could not be analysed. Edition 001 also covers regional differences and caption patterns that could draw a regulator’s attention.
